Tests inject a closure.\n    `model_override`: global override for all calls (e.g. forcing one model in tests).\n    `role_model_overrides`: per-role override applied when `model_override` is None.\n        Used by S43b-BULL fix (DEFER-S43b-3): map BULL → haiku to side-step the\n        300s sonnet timeout that empirically reproduces 2/2 dogfood runs.\n        Resolution order (first wins): model_override → role_model_overrides[role]\n        → _ROLE_TO_MODEL[role] → _DEFAULT_MODEL.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    transport: Callable[[str, str, str, float], tuple[str, int, int]] = field(\n        default=_default_transport\n    )","newString":"@dataclass\nclass ClaudeLLMPerspectiveAdapter:\n    \"\"\"Claude CLI subagent wrapper for perspective agent LLM calls.\n\n    `transport`: pluggable (model, system_prompt, user_message, temperature) -> (text, in_tok, out_tok).\n    Default routes via `claude_cli_transport` (subscription billing; D-050 + D-052).\n    Tests inject a stub closure to bypass subprocess.\n    `model_override`: global override for all calls (e.g. forcing one model in tests).\n    `role_model_overrides`: per-role override applied when `model_override` is None.\n        Used by S43b-BULL fix (DEFER-S43b-3): map BULL → haiku to side-step the\n        300s sonnet timeout that empirically reproduces 2/2 dogfood runs.\n        Resolution order (first wins): model_override → role_model_overrides[role]\n        → _ROLE_TO_MODEL[role] → _DEFAULT_MODEL.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    transport: Callable[[str, str, str, float], tuple[str, int, int]] = field(\n        default=claude_cli_transport\n    )","originalFile":"\"\"\"ClaudeLLMPerspectiveAdapter — claude CLI subagent wrapper for perspective agents.\n\nHARD BINDING (D-050 + D-052 + L-S227-1, 2026-05-09): default transport is the\nClaude Code subscription via `claude_cli_transport` subprocess substrate. The\nlegacy anthropic SDK code-path is fully removed (D-052); CLAUDE.md hard rule\nforbids `import anthropic` / `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in production code.\n\nPattern reused from packages/infrastructure/news/claude_llm_extractor.py (S36).\n\nKey features:\n- temperature=0.0 pinned for reproducibility (AC-5; ignored by CLI substrate)\n- prompt_hash: sha256[:16] of system prompt (reproducibility audit)\n- cost_usd: computed from input + output token counts (Decimal; never float)\n- Default transport routes via claude CLI subprocess (subscription billing)\n- context_to_str: converts SharedContext to a user message string\n\nLLM call signature:\n  call_llm(system_prompt, context, role) -> (raw_json_str, cost_usd, model_id, prompt_hash)\n\nModel routing per spec § B.10:\n- Bear/Bull: claude-sonnet-4-6 ($3/MTok in + $15/MTok out)\n- Quant/Synthesizer: claude-opus-4-7 ($15/MTok in + $75/MTok out)\n\nCostBudgetExceeded is not raised here — cost tracking is the use case's job via\nCostTrackerPort. This adapter only COMPUTES cost_usd per call.\n\nSource: specs/tier2-feature/006-phase-2-track-F-thesis-pipeline.md § B.10 + § B.11.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nimport logging\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom packages.domain.analysis.models.perspective_analysis import PerspectiveRole\nfrom packages.infrastructure.analysis.subagent_transport import claude_cli_transport\n\n__all__ = [\"ClaudeLLMPerspectiveAdapter\"]\n\nlog = logging.getLogger(__name__)\n\n# Model IDs per spec § B.10 (+ Haiku for per-role override per S43b-BULL DEFER-S43b-3 fix)\n_SONNET_MODEL = \"claude-sonnet-4-6\"\n_OPUS_MODEL = \"claude-opus-4-7\"\n_HAIKU_MODEL = \"claude-haiku-4-5\"\n\n# Cost per million tokens (USD) — spec § B.10 / A.10 data provenance.\n# Haiku rate: Anthropic public pricing (Haiku 4.5 = $1.00 in / $5.00 out per MTok).\n# In subagent transport path, CLI-reported total_cost_usd is the source of truth\n# (logged at log.info); these rates are used when SDK transport returns raw token counts.\n_COST_PER_MTOK: dict[str, dict[str, Decimal]] = {\n    _SONNET_MODEL: {\n        \"input\": Decimal(\"3.00\"),\n        \"output\": Decimal(\"15.00\"),\n    },\n    _OPUS_MODEL: {\n        \"input\": Decimal(\"15.00\"),\n        \"output\": Decimal(\"75.00\"),\n    },\n    _HAIKU_MODEL: {\n        \"input\": Decimal(\"1.00\"),\n        \"output\": Decimal(\"5.00\"),\n    },\n}\n\n# Role → model routing per spec § B.10\n_ROLE_TO_MODEL: dict[PerspectiveRole, str] = {\n    PerspectiveRole.BEAR: _SONNET_MODEL,\n    PerspectiveRole.BULL: _SONNET_MODEL,\n    PerspectiveRole.QUANT: _OPUS_MODEL,\n}\n_DEFAULT_MODEL = _OPUS_MODEL  # synthesizer and fallback\n\n\ndef _compute_cost(model: str, input_tokens: int, output_tokens: int) -> Decimal:\n    \"\"\"Deterministic cost computation from token counts. No LLM math — pure arithmetic.\"\"\"\n    rates = _COST_PER_MTOK.get(model, _COST_PER_MTOK[_DEFAULT_MODEL])\n    cost = (\n        rates[\"input\"] * Decimal(input_tokens) / Decimal(\"1_000_000\")\n        + rates[\"output\"] * Decimal(output_tokens) / Decimal(\"1_000_000\")\n    )\n    return cost\n\n\ndef _context_to_str(context: object) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Convert SharedContext to a user message string for the LLM.\n\n    Only includes data that LLM should interpret — never produces numbers itself.\n    Numbers from ratios_ttm are passed verbatim (already code-computed).\n    \"\"\"\n    parts: list[str] = []\n\n    ticker_symbol = str(getattr(getattr(context, \"ticker\", None), \"symbol\", \"UNKNOWN\"))\n    as_of = str(getattr(context, \"as_of\", \"\"))\n    parts.append(f\"=== SharedContext for {ticker_symbol} as_of={as_of} ===\\n\")\n\n    quotes = getattr(context, \"quotes\", [])\n    if quotes:\n        parts.append(f\"[Bar History] {len(quotes)} bars loaded.\\n\")\n        # Include last bar details safely\n        last_bar = quotes[-1]\n        last_close = getattr(last_bar, \"close\", None)\n        last_date = getattr(last_bar, \"period_end\", None)\n        if last_close is not None:\n            parts.append(f\"  Latest close: {last_close} as of {last_date}\\n\")\n\n    statements = getattr(context, \"statements\", None)\n    if statements is not None:\n        filing_date = getattr(statements, \"filing_date\", None)\n        parts.append(f\"[Fundamentals] Filing date: {filing_date}\\n\")\n\n    ratios = getattr(context, \"ratios_ttm\", {})\n    if ratios:\n        parts.append(\"[TTM Ratios — computed by code; interpret only]\\n\")\n        for name, ratio in ratios.items():\n            val = getattr(ratio, \"value\", ratio)\n            audit = getattr(ratio, \"formula_audit\", \"\")\n            parts.append(f\"  {name}: {val}  -- formula: {audit}\\n\")\n\n    ta_features = getattr(context, \"ta_features\", {})\n    ta_audit = getattr(context, \"ta_audit\", {})\n    if ta_features:\n        parts.append(\"[TA Features — computed by code; interpret only]\\n\")\n        for name, value in ta_features.items():\n            audit_key = \"sma_N\" if str(name).startswith(\"sma_\") else str(name)\n            audit = ta_audit.get(audit_key, \"\") if isinstance(ta_audit, dict) else \"\"\n            parts.append(f\"  {name}: {value}  -- formula: {audit}\\n\")\n\n    news = getattr(context, \"recent_news\", [])\n    claims = getattr(context, \"recent_claims\", [])\n    parts.append(f\"[News] {len(news)} articles / {len(claims)} claims in last 90 days.\\n\")\n    for claim in claims[:10]:  # top 10 claims\n        text = getattr(claim, \"claim_text\", \"\")\n        url = getattr(claim, \"source_url\", \"\")\n        excerpt = getattr(claim, \"source_text_excerpt\", \"\")\n        sentiment = str(getattr(claim, \"sentiment\", \"\"))\n        parts.append(f\"  CLAIM [{sentiment}]: {text[:200]}\\n  SOURCE: {url}\\n  EXCERPT: {excerpt[:200]}\\n\")\n    # When claims are absent (extraction not yet run), surface news articles\n    # directly so the LLM has grounded source_url + body_excerpt to cite.\n    if not claims:\n        for art in news[:10]:\n            title = getattr(art, \"title\", \"\")\n            url = getattr(art, \"source_url\", \"\")\n            excerpt = getattr(art, \"body_excerpt\", \"\")\n            published = getattr(art, \"published_at\", \"\")\n            parts.append(\n                f\"  NEWS: {title[:160]}\\n  SOURCE: {url}\\n  PUBLISHED: {published}\\n  EXCERPT: {excerpt[:300]}\\n\"\n            )\n\n    gaps = getattr(context, \"gaps\", [])\n    if gaps:\n        parts.append(f\"[Data Gaps] {gaps}\\n\")\n\n    return \"\".join(parts)\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ClaudeLLMPerspectiveAdapter:\n    \"\"\"Anthropic SDK wrapper for perspective agent LLM calls.\n\n    `transport`: pluggable (model, system_prompt, user_message, temperature) -> (text, in_tok, out_tok).\n    Default uses anthropic.Anthropic lazily. Tests inject a closure.\n    `model_override`: global override for all calls (e.g. forcing one model in tests).\n    `role_model_overrides`: per-role override applied when `model_override` is None.\n        Used by S43b-BULL fix (DEFER-S43b-3): map BULL → haiku to side-step the\n        300s sonnet timeout that empirically reproduces 2/2 dogfood runs.\n        Resolution order (first wins): model_override → role_model_overrides[role]\n        → _ROLE_TO_MODEL[role] → _DEFAULT_MODEL.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    transport: Callable[[str, str, str, float], tuple[str, int, int]] = field(\n        default=_default_transport\n    )\n    model_override: str | None = None\n    role_model_overrides: dict[PerspectiveRole, str] | None = None\n    temperature: float = 0.0  # AC-5 reproducibility\n\n    async def call_llm(\n        self,\n        system_prompt: str,\n        context: object,\n        role: PerspectiveRole,\n    ) -> tuple[str, Decimal, str, str]:\n        \"\"\"Call the LLM with role-appropriate model and return structured output.\n\n        Returns (raw_json_str, cost_usd, model_id, prompt_hash).\n        raw_json_str is expected to be a JSON string matching PerspectiveAnalysis schema.\n        \"\"\"\n        model = (\n            self.model_override\n            or (self.role_model_overrides or {}).get(role)\n            or _ROLE_TO_MODEL.get(role, _DEFAULT_MODEL)\n        )\n        user_message = _context_to_str(context)\n        prompt_hash = hashlib.sha256(system_prompt.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()[:16]\n\n        try:\n            raw_text, input_tokens, output_tokens = self.transport(\n                model, system_prompt, user_message, self.temperature\n            )\n        except Exception as exc:\n            log.error(\"LLM call failed for role=%s model=%s: %s\", role, model, exc)\n            # Return empty key_points JSON — caller handles insufficient case\n            return (\n                json.dumps({\"key_points\": []}),\n                Decimal(\"0\"),\n                model,\n                prompt_hash,\n            )\n\n        cost_usd = _compute_cost(model, input_tokens, output_tokens)\n\n        # Validate response is parseable JSON\n        try:\n            parsed = json.loads(raw_text)\n            if not isinstance(parsed, dict):\n                log.warning(\n                    \"LLM response not a dict for role=%s; wrapping. Snippet: %s\",\n                    role, raw_text[:300],\n                )\n                raw_text = json.dumps({\"key_points\": []})\n        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:\n            log.warning(\n                \"LLM response not valid JSON for role=%s (%s); defaulting empty. \"\n                \"Snippet (first 600 chars): %s\",\n                role, exc, raw_text[:600],\n            )\n            raw_text = json.dumps({\"key_points\": []})\n\n        return raw_text, cost_usd, model, prompt_hash\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":160,"oldLines":10,"newStart":160,"newLines":11,"lines":[" "," @dataclass"," class ClaudeLLMPerspectiveAdapter:","-    \"\"\"Anthropic SDK wrapper for perspective agent LLM calls.","+    \"\"\"Claude CLI subagent wrapper for perspective agent LLM calls."," ","     `transport`: pluggable (model, system_prompt, user_message, temperature) -> (text, in_tok, out_tok).","-    Default uses anthropic.Anthropic lazily. Tests inject a closure.","+    Default routes via `claude_cli_transport` (subscription billing; D-050 + D-052).","+    Tests inject a stub closure to bypass subprocess.","     `model_override`: global override for all calls (e.g. forcing one model in tests).","     `role_model_overrides`: per-role override applied when `model_override` is None.","         Used by S43b-BULL fix (DEFER-S43b-3): map BULL → haiku to side-step the"]},{"oldStart":173,"oldLines":7,"newStart":174,"newLines":7,"lines":["     \"\"\""," ","     transport: Callable[[str, str, str, float], tuple[str, int, int]] = field(","-        default=_default_transport","+        default=claude_cli_transport","     )","     model_override: str | None = None","     role_model_overrides: dict[PerspectiveRole, str] | None = None"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"2cb20cb0-34f4-4b46-b14b-64180e7794ca","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"1fbbb246-77d7-43d7-9158-7912529d0f61","version":"2.1.126","gitBranch":"main"}

You MUST follow these\nrules absolutely:\n\nRULE 1 — NO LLM MATH. Do not produce numeric scores, do not estimate price\nimpact, do not aggregate. Sentiment is one of five categorical labels:\nstrongly_bullish | bullish | neutral | bearish | strongly_bearish.\n\nRULE 2 — GROUNDING. Every claim must include a `source_text_excerpt`: a\nverbatim quote from the article body (≤500 characters) that supports the\nclaim. If you cannot quote the article verbatim, do NOT emit the claim.\n\nRULE 3 — ENTITY GROUNDING. Every claim must mention at least one ticker\n(uppercase 3-letter VN symbol) or sector. Claims with no entities are noise\nand must be omitted.\n\nRULE 4 — OUTPUT. Return ONLY a JSON object of the form\n`{\"claims\": [...]}`. No prose, no markdown fences, no preamble.\n\"\"\"\n\n_PROMPT_HASH = hashlib.sha256(_SYSTEM_PROMPT.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()[:16]\n\n\ndef _default_transport(system_prompt: str, body: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"DEPRECATED — legacy anthropic SDK transport. Raises NotImplementedError.\n\n    Retained as an explicit deprecation marker per D-050 + D-051. Production\n    code MUST use `claude_cli_news_transport` (the new dataclass default).\n    Tests inject a stub closure directly. See L-S227-1 + CLAUDE.md hard rule.\n    \"\"\"\n    raise NotImplementedError(\n        \"anthropic SDK transport deprecated per D-050 / D-051 / L-S227-1. \"\n        \"Use claude_cli_news_transport (default) or inject a test stub.\"\n    )\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ClaudeLlmExtractor:\n    \"\"\"LlmExtractorPort adapter backed by the Anthropic SDK.\n\n    `transport`: pluggable string-in / string-out call (system prompt + body\n    → raw response text). The default uses anthropic.Anthropic; tests\n    inject a closure over recorded responses.\n    `clock`: time source for ExtractorMetadata.extracted_at.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    transport: Callable[[str, str], str] = claude_cli_news_transport\n    clock: Callable[[], datetime] = field(\n        default_factory=lambda: lambda: datetime.now(UTC)\n    )\n    model: str = _DEFAULT_MODEL\n    version: str = _DEFAULT_VERSION\n    system_prompt: str = _SYSTEM_PROMPT\n\n    def extract(self, article: NewsArticle) -> list[ExtractedClaim]:\n        body = self._build_user_message(article)\n        try:\n            raw = self.transport(self.system_prompt, body)\n        except Exception:\n            return []\n        try:\n            payload = json.loads(raw)\n        except json.JSONDecodeError:\n            return []\n        if not isinstance(payload, dict):\n            return []\n        raw_claims = payload.get(\"claims\")\n        if not isinstance(raw_claims, list):\n            return []\n        prompt_hash = hashlib.sha256(\n            self.system_prompt.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()[:16]\n        extracted_at = self.clock()\n        out: list[ExtractedClaim] = []\n        for ordinal, raw_claim in enumerate(raw_claims):\n            claim = self._build_claim(\n                raw_claim,\n                article=article,\n                ordinal=ordinal,\n                extracted_at=extracted_at,\n                prompt_hash=prompt_hash,\n            )\n            if claim is not None:\n                out.append(claim)\n        return out\n\n    def _build_user_message(self, article: NewsArticle) -> str:\n        return (\n            f\"URL: {article.source_url}\\n\"\n            f\"TITLE: {article.title}\\n\\n\"\n            f\"BODY:\\n{article.body_excerpt}\"\n        )\n\n    def _build_claim(\n        self,\n        raw: object,\n        *,\n        article: NewsArticle,\n        ordinal: int,\n        extracted_at: datetime,\n        prompt_hash: str,\n    ) -> ExtractedClaim | None:\n        if not isinstance(raw, dict):\n            return None\n        try:\n            claim_text = str(raw[\"claim_text\"])\n            excerpt = str(raw[\"source_text_excerpt\"])\n            sentiment = Sentiment(str(raw[\"sentiment\"]))\n            confidence = float(raw.get(\"confidence\", 0.5))\n        except (KeyError, ValueError):\n            return None\n        tickers = tuple(\n            Ticker(str(t)) for t in raw.get(\"mentioned_tickers\", [])\n            if isinstance(t, str) and t.isupper() and 2 <= len(t) <= 4\n        )\n        sectors = tuple(\n            str(s) for s in raw.get(\"mentioned_sectors\", [])\n            if isinstance(s, str)\n        )\n        if not tickers and not sectors:\n            return None\n        key_phrases = tuple(\n            str(p) for p in raw.get(\"key_phrases\", [])\n            if isinstance(p, str)\n        )\n        tone_indicators = tuple(\n            str(t) for t in raw.get(\"tone_indicators\", [])\n            if isinstance(t, str)\n        )\n        meta = ExtractorMetadata(\n            extractor_model=self.model,\n            extractor_version=self.version,\n            extractor_prompt_hash=prompt_hash,\n            extracted_at=extracted_at,\n            confidence_extracted=max(0.0, min(1.0, confidence)),\n            verified_by_human=False,\n        )\n        try:\n            return ExtractedClaim(\n                claim_id=f\"{article.article_id}:{ordinal}\",\n                article_id=article.article_id,\n                source_url=article.source_url,\n                source_text_excerpt=excerpt[:500],\n                claim_text=claim_text,\n                sentiment=sentiment,\n                extractor=meta,\n                mentioned_tickers=tickers,\n                mentioned_sectors=sectors,\n                key_phrases=key_phrases,\n                tone_indicators=tone_indicators,\n            )\n        except ValueError:\n            return None\n\n    @property\n    def prompt_hash(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Exposed for callers that want to log the prompt hash without\n production calls inherit the parent CLAUDE.md prompt cache\nvia the CLI substrate.\n\nThe adapter is fixture-friendly: tests inject a `transport` callable\n(prompt: str, body: str) -> str (raw LLM JSON response) so CI never touches\nthe network or subprocess.\n\nReturned JSON contract (system prompt enforces; adapter validates):\n```\n{\n  \"claims\": [\n    {\n      \"claim_text\": str,\n      \"source_text_excerpt\": str (≤500 chars verbatim quote),\n      \"sentiment\": \"strongly_bullish\" | \"bullish\" | \"neutral\"\n                  | \"bearish\" | \"strongly_bearish\",\n      \"mentioned_tickers\": [str, ...],\n      \"mentioned_sectors\": [str, ...],\n      \"key_phrases\": [str, ...],\n      \"tone_indicators\": [str, ...],\n      \"confidence\": float [0, 1]\n    }\n  ]\n}\n```\n\nSource: financial-data-protocol.md Rule 6 + Rule 7;\nspecs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md § B.2;\n.claude/skills/claude-api/SKILL.md.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport json\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom datetime import UTC, datetime\n\nfrom packages.contracts import Ticker\nfrom packages.domain.news.models import ExtractedClaim, NewsArticle\nfrom packages.domain.news.value_objects import ExtractorMetadata, Sentiment\n\nfrom .claude_cli_news_transport import claude_cli_news_transport\n\n__all__ = [\"ClaudeLlmExtractor\"]\n\n\n_DEFAULT_MODEL = \"claude-sonnet-4-6\"\n_DEFAULT_VERSION = \"stockforge-news-extractor-0.1\"\n\n_SYSTEM_PROMPT = \"\"\"You are a Vietnamese stock-market news claim extractor.\n\nYour job is to read one Vietnamese financial-news article and emit a JSON\nobject describing the structured claims it contains. You MUST follow these\nrules absolutely:\n\nRULE 1 — NO LLM MATH. Do not produce numeric scores, do not estimate price\nimpact, do not aggregate. Sentiment is one of five categorical labels:\nstrongly_bullish | bullish | neutral | bearish | strongly_bearish.\n\nRULE 2 — GROUNDING. Every claim must include a `source_text_excerpt`: a\nverbatim quote from the article body (≤500 characters) that supports the\nclaim. If you cannot quote the article verbatim, do NOT emit the claim.\n\nRULE 3 — ENTITY GROUNDING. Every claim must mention at least one ticker\n(uppercase 3-letter VN symbol) or sector. Claims with no entities are noise\nand must be omitted.\n\nRULE 4 — OUTPUT. Return ONLY a JSON object of the form\n`{\"claims\": [...]}`. No prose, no markdown fences, no preamble.\n\"\"\"\n\n_PROMPT_HASH = hashlib.sha256(_SYSTEM_PROMPT.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()[:16]\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ClaudeLlmExtractor:\n    \"\"\"LlmExtractorPort adapter backed by the Anthropic SDK.\n\n    `transport`: pluggable string-in / string-out call (system prompt + body\n    → raw response text). The default uses anthropic.Anthropic; tests\n    inject a closure over recorded responses.\n    `clock`: time source for ExtractorMetadata.extracted_at.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    transport: Callable[[str, str], str] = claude_cli_news_transport\n    clock: Callable[[], datetime] = field(\n        default_factory=lambda: lambda: datetime.now(UTC)\n    )\n    model: str = _DEFAULT_MODEL\n    version: str = _DEFAULT_VERSION\n    system_prompt: str = _SYSTEM_PROMPT\n\n    def extract(self, article: NewsArticle) -> list[ExtractedClaim]:\n        body = self._build_user_message(article)\n        try:\n            raw = self.transport(self.system_prompt, body)\n        except Exception:\n            return []\n        try:\n            payload = json.loads(raw)\n        except json.JSONDecodeError:\n            return []\n        if not isinstance(payload, dict):\n            return []\n        raw_claims = payload.get(\"claims\")\n        if not isinstance(raw_claims, list):\n            return []\n        prompt_hash = hashlib.sha256(\n            self.system_prompt.encode(\"utf-8\")\n        ).hexdigest()[:16]\n        extracted_at = self.clock()\n        out: list[ExtractedClaim] = []\n        for ordinal, raw_claim in enumerate(raw_claims):\n            claim = self._build_claim(\n                raw_claim,\n                article=article,\n                ordinal=ordinal,\n                extracted_at=extracted_at,\n                prompt_hash=prompt_hash,\n            )\n            if claim is not None:\n                out.append(claim)\n        return out\n\n    def _build_user_message(self, article: NewsArticle) -> str:\n        return (\n            f\"URL: {article.source_url}\\n\"\n            f\"TITLE: {article.title}\\n\\n\"\n            f\"BODY:\\n{article.body_excerpt}\"\n        )\n\n    def _build_claim(\n        self,\n        raw: object,\n        *,\n        article: NewsArticle,\n        ordinal: int,\n        extracted_at: datetime,\n        prompt_hash: str,\n    ) -> ExtractedClaim | None:\n        if not isinstance(raw, dict):\n            return None\n        try:\n            claim_text = str(raw[\"claim_text\"])\n            excerpt = str(raw[\"source_text_excerpt\"])\n            sentiment = Sentiment(str(raw[\"sentiment\"]))\n            confidence = float(raw.get(\"confidence\", 0.5))\n        except (KeyError, ValueError):\n            return None\n        tickers = tuple(\n            Ticker(str(t)) for t in raw.get(\"mentioned_tickers\", [])\n            if isinstance(t, str) and t.isupper() and 2 <= len(t) <= 4\n        )\n        sectors = tuple(\n            str(s) for s in raw.get(\"mentioned_sectors\", [])\n            if isinstance(s, str)\n        )\n        if not tickers and not sectors:\n            return None\n        key_phrases = tuple(\n            str(p) for p in raw.get(\"key_phrases\", [])\n            if isinstance(p, str)\n        )\n        tone_indicators = tuple(\n            str(t) for t in raw.get(\"tone_indicators\", [])\n            if isinstance(t, str)\n        )\n        meta = ExtractorMetadata(\n            extractor_model=self.model,\n            extractor_version=self.version,\n            extractor_prompt_hash=prompt_hash,\n            extracted_at=extracted_at,\n            confidence_extracted=max(0.0, min(1.0, confidence)),\n            verified_by_human=False,\n        )\n        try:\n            return ExtractedClaim(\n                claim_id=f\"{article.article_id}:{ordinal}\",\n                article_id=article.article_id,\n                source_url=article.source_url,\n                source_text_excerpt=excerpt[:500],\n                claim_text=claim_text,\n                sentiment=sentiment,\n                extractor=meta,\n                mentioned_tickers=tickers,\n                mentioned_sectors=sectors,\n                key_phrases=key_phrases,\n                tone_indicators=tone_indicators,\n            )\n        except ValueError:\n            return None\n\n    @property\n    def prompt_hash(self) -> str:\n        \"\"\"Exposed for callers that want to log the prompt hash without\n        triggering an extraction (e.g. CLI startup banner).\n        \"\"\"\n        return _PROMPT_HASH\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":11,"oldLines":8,"newStart":11,"newLines":8,"lines":[" via the CLI path: agent-workspace/memory/decisions/051-S228-news-extractor-subagent-refactor.md\n    section: D-051 § follow_ups — \"D-052 SDK code-path removal: delete `_default_transport` deprecation stubs in claude_llm_perspective_adapter.py + claude_llm_extractor.py + drop `anthropic` from pyproject.toml\"\n  - path: CLAUDE.md\n    section: StockForge Hard Rules — NO ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / NO direct anthropic SDK in production code (appended S227)\n  - path: agent-workspace/memory/agent-notes.md\n    section: L-S227-1 critical-severity rule (auto-detect=yes)\n\nintent_classification:\n  primary_intent: ARCH\n  affects_charter: false\n  affects_scope: false\n  urgency: NORMAL\n\ndecision: |\n  Complete the D-050/D-051 chain by removing all anthropic SDK code-paths from\n  production:\n\n  1. `packages/infrastructure/analysis/claude_llm_perspective_adapter.py`:\n     delete the `_default_transport` function (was a real anthropic SDK call,\n     not a deprecation stub — D-050 only flipped the use_case_builder default).\n     Set the dataclass `transport` default to `claude_cli_transport` from the\n     same-BC sibling module `subagent_transport.py` (no cross-BC import).\n  2. `packages/infrastructure/news/claude_llm_extractor.py`: delete the\n     `_default_transport` deprecation-marker stub authored at D-051. Default\n     was already `claude_cli_news_transport`; the stub is now dead code.\n  3. `pyproject.toml`: remove `anthropic>=0.40.0` from dependencies. Keep\n     `anthropic` in `[[tool.importlinter.contracts]] forbidden_modules` as a\n     defensive boundary (regression detector even after the dep is gone).\n  4. `packages/infrastructure/news/test_adapters.py`: replace the\n     NotImplementedError-deprecation test with a regression test that asserts\n     (a) `_default_transport` symbol no longer exists on the module and (b) no\n     real `import anthropic` / `from anthropic` statement leaks back in.\n\nrationale: |\n  D-050 (S227) made subagent the canonical default but left two real anthropic\n  SDK code-paths intact: the news extractor `_default_transport` (real SDK\n  call) and the analysis adapter `_default_transport` (real SDK call). D-051\n  (S228) replaced the news-extractor real-SDK call with a NotImplementedError\n  stub plus authored a sibling subagent transport. The analysis adapter still\n  carried the SDK call until D-052.\n\n  Surgical removal (P3): no new files, ~30 LOC deleted across 3 files, no\n  signature changes to public API. Tests injecting `transport=` callable\n  continue to work unchanged. Symbol-existence regression test ensures the\n  stub does not silently re-creep into production via future copy-paste.\n\ntrade_offs: |\n  (+) Honors L-S227-1 critical-severity rule fully — no `import anthropic`\n      remaining in production-code paths (`apps/**` + `packages/**`).\n  (+) `pyproject.toml` ships smaller dep surface; one fewer license/version\n      pin to track; `pip install` faster.\n  (+) Cost model unchanged: subscription pre-paid, ~$0 marginal per call.\n  (-) Direct dataclass instantiation of either adapter without a builder will\n      now hit `claude` CLI subprocess on first use. Tests must inject a stub\n      (already the existing pattern in test_adapters.py + test_perspective_adapter.py).\n  (-) `vendor-api-probe` firing-test fixture intentionally uses `import anthropic`\n      inside a heredoc to test the probe DETECTING missing anthropic; that's a\n      shell-script test fixture, not production import — kept as-is.\n\nempirical_close_verify:\n  - \"py_compile all 3 edited files = OK\"\n  - \"pytest packages/infrastructure/news/ packages/infrastructure/analysis/ packages/application/analysis/ packages/domain/analysis/ apps/_shared/ apps/cli/test_validate_thesis.py = 125 PASS in 0.83s\"\n  - \"firing-tests/run-all.sh = 86/86 PASS in 236s zero regression vs S228 baseline\"\n  - \"Production-code grep `^[ \\\\t]*(?:import\\\\s+anthropic|from\\\\s+anthropic\\\\b)` in apps/+packages/ = 0 hits\"\n\nfollow_ups:\n  - \"D10 drift-signal hook: now ZERO production references; hook can run with strict-zero-tolerance threshold + companion firing-test. Production code is now\n# clean (D-052 removed all SDK call paths). Test fixture files\n  # (test_*.py / *_test.py) MAY contain monkeypatch.delenv(\"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY\")\n  # for negative-path testing — kept allow-listed via path filter.\n  local hits\n  hits=\"$(grep -rEn '^[[:space:]]*(import[[:space:]]+anthropic|from[[:space:]]+anthropic\\b)' \\\n    \"$dir\" --include='*.py' 2>/dev/null \\\n    | grep -vE '/(test_[^/]*\\.py|[^/]*_test\\.py):' \\\n    | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]' || echo 0)\"\n  [[ \"$hits\" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || hits=0\n  if [ \"$hits\" -gt 0 ]; then\n    emit \"HIGH\" \"scope=$dir kind=import-anthropic count=$hits\"\n  fi\n\n  local key_hits\n  key_hits=\"$(grep -rEn 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY' \"$dir\" --include='*.py' 2>/dev/null \\\n    | grep -vE '/(test_[^/]*\\.py|[^/]*_test\\.py):' \\\n    | grep -vE '^[^:]+:[0-9]+:[[:space:]]*#' \\\n    | wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]' || echo 0)\"\n  [[ \"$key_hits\" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || key_hits=0\n  if [ \"$key_hits\" -gt 0 ]; then\n    emit \"HIGH\" \"scope=$dir kind=ANTHROPIC_API_KEY count=$key_hits\"\n  fi\n}\n\nscan_dir \"$PROJECT_DIR/apps\"\nscan_dir \"$PROJECT_DIR/packages\"\n\nif [ \"$VIOLATIONS\" -gt 0 ]; then\n  echo \"[$TS] no-anthropic-sdk-d10: $VIOLATIONS violation(s) — see $LOG\" >> \"$HOOK_LOG\"\nfi\n\n# Strict mode: exit non-zero if any HIGH violation (blocks Stop hook chain).\n# Default: emit-only; user can opt into strict via STOCKFORGE_D10_STRICT=1.\nif [ \"${STOCKFORGE_D10_STRICT:-0}\" = \"1\" ] && [ \"$VIOLATIONS\" -gt 0 ]; then\n  exit 1\nfi\nexit 0\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":49,"oldLines":10,"newStart":49,"newLines":14,"lines":["     emit \"HIGH\" \"scope=$dir kind=import-anthropic count=$hits\"","   fi"," ","+  # ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: only flag real env-var access","+  # (`os.environ[\"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY\"]`, `os.environ.get(...)`, `os.getenv(...)`,","+  # `env[\"...\"]`).
